narrative.overview:
This design system frames a software engineer's portfolio against an immediate, deep-space canvas (`space-void`) that prioritizes fast first paint and effortless reading on both high-DPI monitors and budget laptops or mobile devices. Atmospheric depth comes from lightweight CSS radial nebulae and a bounded viewport starfield rather than heavy full-page shaders.

Every surface feels direct, confident, and responsive: cards sit quietly in dark tonal layers with hairline borders at rest, reserving luminous accents and subtle motion for direct user interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Always-dark space canvas with zero light-mode flash.
Flat-by-default tonal cards that reveal subtle violet/blue accents on hover.
Crisp geometric sans-serif typography (`Inter` and `Inter Tight`) tuned for high-contrast scanning.
Lightweight, `prefers-reduced-motion`-aware transitions that never block content visibility.

rules.name: The Always-Dark Canvas Rule
rules.body: The root document never falls back to a light background regardless of OS color scheme; `color-scheme: dark` and `space-void` are always active so light foreground text is never stranded.

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Cobalt and Vivid Violet are reserved for interactive triggers, active states, and hover highlights; body copy and card backgrounds stay strictly neutral.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards and containers rest flat against the space backdrop with 1px hairline borders; colored glows and elevation shadows activate strictly on hover or focus.

dos: Do keep background effects bounded to the viewport (`position: fixed`) with `devicePixelRatio` capped at `1.5` and static fallbacks for `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
Do keep hero LCP elements (such as the profile avatar) immediately visible (`opacity: 1`) without blocking behind delayed IntersectionObserver reveals.
Do host company logos and recurring UI icons locally in `public/icons/` so external CDNs or hotlink limits never break cards.
donts: Don't run multi-pass per-pixel WebGL fragment shaders across full-document-height canvases.
Don't rely on OS `prefers-color-scheme: light` to set a light page background on this dark-themed portfolio.
Don't animate layout-triggering properties (`width`, `height`, `top`, `left`) or leave continuous `animate-pulse` repaints on large blurred layers.
